reviews.text:
I absolutely love this shampoo!

I’ve bought it quite a few times now and this is my first cleanse shampoo, with Labo-H for my second cleanse, and these are the only products I use now. 

Since changing my routine to these shampoos, my dry & flaky scalp has cleared completely and I no longer get that itchy feeling after not washing for 3-4 days. I can go up to a week now between washes (which is much better for my drier curly hair) without it looking or feeling greasy.

I’d say that my hair is now in the best condition it’s ever been in.

The Aromatica shampoo lathers really well, smells nice and did leave my hair with the tingly menthol feeling when I first started using it, but I don’t notice that anymore.

It does a great job of thoroughly cleaning my hair after I’ve styled it curly, which is no mean feat, as it takes a ton of mousse, gel and hairspray to make my curls look nice.

This is definitely part of my regular routine now.
reviews.zh:
我非常鍾意呢款洗頭水！

我已經買咗好多次。呢款係我嘅第一步清潔洗頭水（first cleanse），第二步清潔就用 Labo-H，而家我淨係用呢啲產品。

自從轉用呢啲洗頭水之後，我嘅乾燥、脫屑頭皮完全好晒，唔使再試過3至4日唔洗頭之後嗰種痕癢感。而家我可以隔足一個禮拜先洗一次頭（對於我乾身啲嘅捲髮嚟講好得多），亦唔會睇落或者感覺油膩。

我會話我嘅頭髮而家係我有史以嚟最好嘅狀態。

Aromatica 洗頭水起泡好好，味道都好好聞，我第一次用嗰陣會有少少薄荷嘅刺麻感，但而家我已經唔覺得。

我整完捲髮之後，佢都可以清潔得好徹底，呢點好難得，因為我要用好多慕絲、啫喱同定型噴霧，先可以令個捲髮好睇。

呢款而家肯定成為咗我日常嘅一部分。

reviews.text: Very disappointing purchase. The shampoo lathers well, but unfortunately, my hair still feels and looks dirty after washing, almost as if I didn’t wash it at all. It doesn’t leave my hair feeling clean, fresh, or lightweight. I really wanted to like this shampoo, but it simply didn’t work for me.
reviews.zh: 非常令人失望嘅購買。洗頭水起泡都好好，但係可惜，洗完之後我嘅頭髮仲係覺得同睇落都好似冇洗過咁。佢令我嘅頭髮唔覺得乾淨、清新或者輕盈。我好想鍾意呢款洗頭水，但佢就係唔啱我。

reviews.text: Very fresh rosemary scent, scent doesn’t last that long after showering though. Really good at properly cleaning my scalp. It needs a minute of lathering, but, when lathered a small amount will go pretty far, and if left on for a few minutes, be really cleansing. It has a very soft and fine lather as well.
reviews.zh: 迷迭香味好清新，不過洗完澡之後香味持續唔係咁耐。清潔頭皮效果好好。要搓大約一分鐘，但係只要用少少就已經好夠，如果留喺頭上幾分鐘，清潔效果會好好。泡沫都好幼滑、軟身。

reviews.text:
this doesn’t have a strong a chemical smell as other scalp treatment types of shampoos. it definitely does have that tea tree smell but it isn’t overpowering. my hair does feel really soft and my scalp does feel super clean BUT because of my hair type I have to use normal shampoo afterwards to make sure that it comes out! 

<my hair is thick, long, curly and wavy>
reviews.zh:
呢款冇其他頭皮護理類洗頭水咁強烈嘅化學味。佢肯定有茶樹嗰種味，但唔會太搶。我頭髮感覺好柔軟，頭皮感覺超乾淨，不過因為我嘅髮質，我之後都要再用普通洗頭水，確保洗得乾淨！

<我嘅頭髮又粗、又長、又卷又浪>

reviews.shade: AROMATICA Rosemary Scalp Scaling Shampoo 400ml (NEW Pump)
reviews.text: The scent is pretty strong and very green so not for everyone. It has noticeably thicken my hair but I have noticed more hair fall too?? It also is quite harsh/drying even with using the conditioner. However, it is still a okay clarifying shampoo.
reviews.zh: 味道幾濃，好青草味，唔係人人都啱用。用完令頭髮明顯變厚咗，但係我又覺得脫髮多咗？？即使用咗護髮素，都幾刺激、乾燥。不過，佢都仲算係一款還可以嘅清潔洗頭水。

reviews.shade: AROMATICA Rosemary Scalp Scaling Shampoo 400ml (NEW Pump)
reviews.text: Got this for two reasons. I straighten my hair and try not to wash it for a while; my scalp was getting really itchy because of that but this has helped noticeably. My boyfriend also uses it for the scalp health and hair growth/thickening benefits. His hair is looking nicer and shinier overall! Smell is a bit strong, and lasts for a while post-wash, but it is a pleasant smell in my opinion.
reviews.zh: 我買呢款有兩個原因。我會拉直頭髮，又會一段時間唔洗頭；因為咁，頭皮痕到好嬲，但呢款明顯幫咗我。我男朋友都用呢款嚟護理頭皮同促進頭髮生長／令頭髮變粗。佢嘅頭髮整體睇落更好、更有光澤！味道有少少濃，洗完之後會留返一段時間，不過我覺得係好聞嘅味道。

reviews.shade: AROMATICA Rosemary Scalp Scaling Shampoo 400ml (NEW Pump)
reviews.text: I was really hopeful for this product as I love Aromatica's root enhancer but I haven't been wow'd by this. It feels like a reasonable shampoo but it didn't have a cooling effect on my hair and I didn't think my hair felt particularly better after washing with it.
reviews.zh: 我對呢款產品好有期望，因為我好鍾意 Aromatica 嘅 root enhancer，但係呢款未令我特別驚喜。佢係一款幾好嘅洗頭水，不過冇令頭髮有清涼感，我都唔覺得洗完之後頭髮特別好咗。

reviews.shade: AROMATICA Rosemary Scalp Scaling Shampoo 400ml (NEW Pump)
reviews.text: Đầu mình siêu dầu mà gội xcong tóc khô,da đầu ngứa quá trời.qua ngày hôm sau tưởng k gội cũng k sao mà tóc bết x2 bình thường :))) may mà mua luc có kupon giá còn hơn 1 sen tẹo nó đỡ tiếc.se trải nghiệm thêm vài lần xem có khác k,nếu k thì phải vứt rồi
reviews.zh: 我個頭好油，但係洗完頭髮都乾晒，頭皮痕到不得了。第二日以為唔洗都冇事，點知頭髮黏咗兩倍，同平時一樣 :))) 幸好買嗰陣有優惠券，價錢都仲有少少平，所以冇咁後悔。我會再試幾次睇有冇分別，如果冇，就要扔咗佢。
